title: Wso2am: Netty is a network application framework for development of protocol servers and clients (CVE-2026-45416)
description: A high-severity security vulnerability (CVE-2026-45416) affects the wso2am package, which uses Netty, a network application framework for protocol servers and clients. The vulnerability impacts availability but does not affect confidentiality or integrity. Fixed versions 4.4.0-r1 and 4.5.0-r4 address the issue.
